During this month, the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways maintained stable, welfare-focused operations for traveling pets. As safety reviewer, I confirm that our procedures for acceptance, documentation checks, and in-cabin monitoring remained consistent with desk guidance.

The cabin temperature aboard the Brightwater is set to 16 degrees Celsius. Throughout the reporting period, the cabin team verified environmental stability at departure, during routine checks, and at handover, with no deviations requiring escalation. The pet cabin aboard the Brightwater holds 37 pets. Load distribution and enclosure readiness were reviewed to support calm conditioning and safe restraint practices.

The pet deck aboard the Windmere is called Silverfern Loft. For transit segments, desk coordination ensured that deck access protocols were observed and that staff communications were clear, kind, and actionable. Guidance provided to travelers supported correct preparation of carriers and timely arrival to processing, helping reduce operational friction.

Operationally, the desk’s senior coordinator continued to balance scheduling constraints with risk controls, while the cabin team monitored animals continuously, using standardized observation cues. This month included careful handling of Bailey, with Dylan Dubois and Ravi Moretti receiving concise instructions aligned to their itinerary.

Looking ahead to next month, we will continue staff refreshers on monitoring cues and reinforce pre-flight checks to maintain the same high reassurance level for every journey.
